subject: Insurance remediation plan + conditional PO approval
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara@clearpathlogistics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: COI and endorsements required for vendor setup (ClearPath Logistics)

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for moving quickly on onboarding. To complete vendor setup and issue a PO we need the following insurance items:

- Certificate of Insurance showing: General Liability $1M per occurrence / $2M aggregate; Auto Liability $1M; Employers Liability $1M.
- Endorsement adding Redwood Inference as Additional Insured (CG 20 10 or equivalent).
- Endorsement confirming Primary & Non-Contributory wording and Waiver of Subrogation in favor of Redwood Inference.
- If ClearPath will use subcontractors, please include a subcontractor schedule or confirm subcontractors are covered under the same policy.
- W-9 (standard).

We can provision a conditional PO to get you into our procurement pipeline so you can start initial work, but the PO will be contingent on receipt of the required endorsements within 30 days. Please confirm: (1) when your insurer can issue the endorsements, and (2) the AP invoice routing (who to send PO references to).

Attachments: sample_endorsement_language.txt (for reference)

Thanks — appreciate a quick turnaround.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Procurement Coordinator
Redwood Inference

Team — forwarding ClearPath's COI. Key gaps: no Additional Insured endorsement, no Waiver of Subrogation, broker wants PO number to reference.

Recommendation: issue a conditional PO with the following controls:
- 30–45 day remediation window for endorsements (I recommend 45 days given broker timelines).
- PO language to require endorsement listing Redwood Inference as Additional Insured and Primary & Non-Contributory; if not delivered within remediation window, Redwood reserves right to suspend work and withhold final payment.
- Finance should accept invoices during the remediation window but hold final settlement until confirmation of endorsements.

Marissa — can procurement/legal provide the exact Additional Insured language to give to the broker? I attached sample language for convenience. If Finance agrees to conditional invoice routing we can issue the PO and provide the PO number to the broker so they can add it to the endorsement request.
